title: Sequencing: factory checks
bodyMd:
A technician performs five different checks in sequence, completing each before starting the next.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Alignment, Balance, Cooling, Drive, Electrical.

- Cooling must occupy position 2 or position 4.
- Electrical must precede Balance.
- Exactly 2 other items must occur between Alignment and Drive.
